wins: Completed full TCP port scan across all discovered hosts, identifying 37 open services for prioritization.
Documented service banners and versions, enabling informed script selection for follow-on enumeration.
Maintained consistent logging and evidence collection, facilitating rapid mentor handoff despite mission failure.
fails: Failed to obtain valid credentials or escalate past initial user context, leaving the chain incomplete.
Repeatedly stalled on exploit development steps due to misconfigured payload staging in the lab environment.
High mentor dependence (15 calls) indicates gaps in autonomous decision-making under time pressure.
key_outcomes.summary: The session produced solid reconnaissance data but lacked follow-through in access acquisition and privilege escalation, leaving the kill chain open-ended.

repeated_failure_patterns.pattern: Unable to translate service enumeration into working initial access attempts, leading to multiple aborted exploit trials.

skill_cards.if_condition: When port 22 is open and SSH banner detected
skill_cards.then_action: Run SSH enumeration with nmap scripts

skill_cards.if_condition: When HTTP service responds with login portal
skill_cards.then_action: Use nikto plus nikto -h <target> to capture directories and POST parameters
Pivot to credential stuffing using discovered username/password pairs with hydra

memory_ops.reason: High success rate in gathering SSH details that seed later actions even when access failed.
Consistent identification of HTTP portals that can be targeted in future experiments.

next_experiments.title: Exploit lab HTTP portal with Burp+wfuzz
next_experiments.description: Use Burp suite to identify hidden POST parameters on the HTTP portal and wfuzz to enumerate directories, then attempt targeted SQLi/LFI payloads.

next_experiments.title: SSH credential brute-force follow-up run
next_experiments.description: Combine usernames from enumeration with curated password list via hydra, log valid combos, and immediately attempt key-based login once a hit is found.
